Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:35.00,Brand,,0,0,0,,DOWE {c&H0051F4BB&}LANCASTER
Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.00,0:00:35.00,Footer,,0,0,0,,WINDOWS TO ROKU  •  LOCAL NETWORK STREAMING

Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.10,0:00:05.80,Kicker,,0,0,175,,{\fad(500,500)}HOW IT WORKS
Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.10,0:00:05.80,Title,,0,0,245,,{\fad(500,500)}Your media. Your screen.\N{c&H0051F4BB&}Your Roku.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:00.10,0:00:05.80,Body,,0,0,390,,{\fad(500,500)}Dowe LanCaster turns videos, links, folders, and your desktop\Ninto a Roku-ready stream over your local network.

Dialogue: 0,0:00:06.00,0:00:11.80,Step,,0,0,140,,{\fad(400,400)}1
Dialogue: 0,0:00:06.00,0:00:11.80,Kicker,,0,0,210,,{\fad(400,400)}INSTALL THE RECEIVER
Dialogue: 0,0:00:06.00,0:00:11.80,Title,,0,0,270,,{\fad(400,400)}Add Dowe LanCaster\Nto your Roku
Dialogue: 0,0:00:06.00,0:00:11.80,Body,,0,0,420,,{\fad(400,400)}Use the included Roku ZIP and the simple sideloading instructions.\NYou only need to install the receiver once.

Dialogue: 0,0:00:12.00,0:00:17.80,Step,,0,0,140,,{\fad(400,400)}2
Dialogue: 0,0:00:12.00,0:00:17.80,Kicker,,0,0,210,,{\fad(400,400)}CHOOSE YOUR ROKU
Dialogue: 0,0:00:12.00,0:00:17.80,Title,,0,0,270,,{\fad(400,400)}Scan automatically\Nor add its IP
Dialogue: 0,0:00:12.00,0:00:17.80,Body,,0,0,420,,{\fad(400,400)}Dowe LanCaster finds Roku devices on the same network.\NSelect the TV where you want your media to play.

Dialogue: 0,0:00:18.00,0:00:23.80,Step,,0,0,140,,{\fad(400,400)}3
Dialogue: 0,0:00:18.00,0:00:23.80,Kicker,,0,0,210,,{\fad(400,400)}PICK WHAT TO CAST
Dialogue: 0,0:00:18.00,0:00:23.80,Title,,0,0,270,,{\fad(400,400)}File  •  Folder  •  Link\NTeraBox  •  Live Desktop
Dialogue: 0,0:00:18.00,0:00:23.80,Body,,0,0,435,,{\fad(400,400)}Choose a source, select your quality and encoder,\Nthen press Play or Start Cast.

Dialogue: 0,0:00:24.00,0:00:29.80,Kicker,,0,0,195,,{\fad(400,400)}LANCASTER HANDLES THE REST
Dialogue: 0,0:00:24.00,0:00:29.80,Title,,0,0,270,,{\fad(400,400)}Converted for Roku.\NStreamed locally.
Dialogue: 0,0:00:24.00,0:00:29.80,Body,,0,0,420,,{\fad(400,400)}FFmpeg creates a compatible stream while Dowe LanCaster\Nkeeps playback and remote controls in one place.

Dialogue: 0,0:00:30.00,0:00:34.80,Kicker,,0,0,205,,{\fad(400,500)}READY FOR THE BIG SCREEN?
Dialogue: 0,0:00:30.00,0:00:34.80,Title,,0,0,280,,{\fad(400,500)}Download Dowe LanCaster
Dialogue: 0,0:00:30.00,0:00:34.80,Body,,0,0,385,,{\fad(400,500)}Install on Windows, connect your Roku, and start casting.
